name: Lelanai
summary: In Darnassus, Lelanai tends the saber mounts kept in the Cenarion Enclave. Night elves and trusted allies may earn a mount from her.

sections.title: Breeder of the Cenarion Enclave
sections.body: Lelanai tends Kalimdor’s great cats in the Cenarion Enclave, beside Jartsam, the riding instructor. Night elves have long bonded with the fierce predators of northern forests. They train nightsabers and frostsabers to carry sentinels and scouts across rugged ground with a predator’s grace. In Darnassus, Lelanai provides these mounts to riders.

sections.title: Bonds Beyond Kinship
sections.body: Lelanai offers saber mounts to skilled night elves, while outsiders must meet a higher bar. The kaldorei hold the cats sacred and keep their distance from strangers. She entrusts a mount to a non-night elf only after they earn the highest respect and renown with Darnassus.

faq.answer: Lelanai is in Darnassus’s Cenarion Enclave, beside Jartsam, the tiger riding trainer.
Lelanai sells reins for several breeds of frostsaber and nightsaber, including swift armored mounts for veteran riders.

faq.q: Can non-night elves buy mounts from Lelanai?
faq.answer: Yes. Non-night elves can buy from Lelanai after earning exalted reputation with Darnassus. Without that standing, she refuses to sell them a mount.

faq.q: Can Horde players interact with Lelanai?
faq.answer: No. Lelanai is loyal to the Alliance in Darnassus. She and the nearby enclave guards treat Horde members as hostile invaders.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can seek Lelanai when you are ready to ride your people’s traditional feline steeds.
As an Alliance hero, you can earn exalted standing with Darnassus and seek Lelanai’s sabers to ride beside your kaldorei allies.
